gmat_focus.note: Not published: the Class of 2027 profile prints "Median GMAT: 655" with a middle 80% range of 615 to 695, and names no GMAT edition. An unlabelled figure could be on either scale, or a mix of both, since GMAT scores of either edition stay valid for five years (GMAC), so it is not filed under one (INC-0157).

notes: All prior Clear Admit sourcing replaced with Foster's own pages. The official class profile shows median GMAT 655 only; no 10th edition (classic) figure is published, so the prior Clear Admit 720 classic median is dropped. Acceptance rate not published on official pages reached. Tuition annualized transparently from the page's per-quarter tuition and its 6-quarter program total (page presents quarterly rates and a 2-year total of 122,778 tuition and fees for nonresidents). The older 2024 employment report (Class of 2024: median base 145,000, 89.0 percent offers within 3 months) was also fetched but superseded by the 2026 report covering the Class of 2025.
